MPETargeterConstraint.description:
One constraint in a maneuver-targeting problem and how well the converged
solution satisfies it.

FRAME.description: Reference frame the constraint is expressed in

EPOCH.description:
Epoch the constraint applies at (UNIX timestamp) [numeric seconds since
1970-01-01T00:00:00 UTC]; 0 when the constraint anchors to EVENT

EVENT.description: Event the constraint anchors to when EPOCH is 0, e.g. "APOAPSIS"

TARGET_VALUE.description: Target value of the constrained quantity

ACHIEVED_VALUE.description: Value achieved by the converged solution

TOLERANCE.description: Acceptable tolerance on the constrained quantity

WEIGHT.description: Relative weight of this constraint in the corrector

MPETargeterSolution.description:
Maneuver-targeter solution and convergence metadata carried with an
extended MPE: the solver that produced the targeted element set, its
iteration/residual history, and the constraint set it satisfied.

DYNAMICS.description: Dynamics contract the solution was targeted under: SGP4, HPOP, CR3BP

CONVERGED.description: Whether the corrector converged within tolerance

RESIDUAL_RMS.description: RMS of the final-iteration constraint residuals

RESIDUALS.description: Final-iteration residual per constraint, aligned with CONSTRAINTS

CONSTRAINTS.description: The constraint set the solution was targeted against

TOTAL_DELTA_V.description: Total delta-v of the solved maneuver sequence in m/s

SOLVED_AT.description: Unix ms the solution was produced

ENTITY_ID.description: Unique ID as a String [no units]

EPOCH.description: Epoch of Mean Keplerian elements (UNIX timestamp) [numeric seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 UTC]

MEAN_MOTION.description: Mean motion in rev/day [M if chosen to represent orbit size for SGP/SGP4 elements]

RA_OF_ASC_NODE.description: Right ascension of ascending node in degrees

BSTAR.description: SGP/SGP4 drag-like coefficient (BSTAR) in units of 1/[Earth radii]

MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY.description: Description of the Mean Element Theory (SGP4, DSST, USM)

TARGETER.description:
Targeter solution + convergence metadata when this element set is the
product of maneuver targeting (absent for ordinary element sets)
